lesson: Ensure core instructions (like rules/ and skills/) remain static and located at the top of the conversation transcript. Keep dynamic content, such as workspace searches or multi-line command logs, at the bottom of the prompt to maximize the hitting rate of the prompt cache.

When editing files, touch only the lines directly related to the user's request. Avoid unsolicited stylistic cleanup or adjacent code refactoring, as it wastes tokens, creates noise in diffs, and increases test failure risks.

Never assign two subagents to modify the same file concurrently. This leads to workspace write conflicts. Always partition work such that files are modified sequentially or combined under a single subagent.

Evaluating %errorlevel% or executing commands inside parenthesized blocks (...) in Windows .bat/cmd scripts can cause unexpected parser crashes (e.g. 'not was unexpected at this time'). Avoid nested parenthesis blocks for control flow; use explicit 'goto' labels and standard errorlevel checks instead.

Running 'ruff check .' at project root will scan downloaded third-party skill folders under '.agent/skills/' and produce false positives/failures. Always configure 'exclude' directories in 'pyproject.toml' to isolate linting to active source/test paths.

Spawning background processes in PowerShell via 'Start-Process' terminates them immediately once the parent non-interactive PowerShell console exits. To run a true persistent daemon on Windows that survives shell exit, use WMI/CIM methods like 'Invoke-CimMethod -ClassName Win32_Process -MethodName Create'.

topic: File Locking and Cleanup Order of Operations
lesson: Attempting to delete a virtual environment directory ('.venv/') while a background watcher or python interpreter is running results in 'Access is denied' errors due to active OS file locks. Always terminate any background watcher or python processes as Step 0 before performing cleanup or modifications on the environment.

Process termination signals sent via taskkill or Stop-Process are asynchronous. Immediately executing file operations after signaling termination can fail because file locks are still being released. Add a short sleep (e.g. 'Start-Sleep -Seconds 1') to guarantee locks are freed by the OS.

topic: Git Status Porcelain Untracked Folder Grouping
lesson: By default, 'git status --porcelain' groups untracked files under their parent directory (e.g. '?? src/') if the directory is completely untracked. To list untracked files individually (especially when newly created), always append the '-u' flag ('git status --porcelain -u').

Piping input to batch commands (e.g. 'echo Y | clean.bat') that use interactive 'set /p' prompts behaves poorly and can trigger aborted/unintended execution paths. Implement explicit non-interactive flags (e.g. '-y' or '/y') in the script parameters to skip prompts cleanly.

topic: TVDB Season Date Gaps & Titles Parsing
lesson: To align anime parts (e.g. split-cour) with TVDB, fetch the TVDB season page and sort episodes. Group episodes by checking if the gap between consecutive dates exceeds 45 days. Cell[0] holds SxxEyy and cell[1] holds the episode title tag. Use BeautifulSoup's get_text(separator=' ') when checking row text for dates to preserve clean word boundaries.

topic: Spanish Subtitle Filtering & Latin American Prioritization
lesson: When scraping video/subtitle sources from API endpoints where all tracks default to lang=en, filter subtitles strictly by label keywords. For Spanish, check for label substrings 'spanish', 'espanol', or 'español', and explicitly exclude 'portuguese' (which contains 'es') to avoid false positives. Prioritize Latin American variants by searching for 'latin america', 'latam', or 'america latina' in track labels.

Map subtitle track labels dynamically to ISO/IETF language sub-tags for media player auto-detection (VLC, PotPlayer, YouTube): 'es-419' for Spanish (Latin America / Latam), 'es-ES' for Spanish (Spain), 'es' for generic Spanish, 'en' for English, and 'vi' for Vietnamese.

topic: Interactive Server Selection Persistence Across Batch Episodes
lesson: In interactive mode, after the user manually selects a server (e.g. Vidstream-2) for the first episode, clean and assign the server name to self.only_server so that subsequent episodes in the batch automatically reuse the chosen server without asking repeatedly.
